payload.description:
As the CEO, I want the active delivery agent to combine product and engineering leadership, so that it challenges priorities, delegates implementation efficiently, and remains accountable for review and outcomes.

Feature: Simplified software delivery leadership

Scenario: Main agent owns product and engineering judgment
Given the human invokes the software delivery team in a human-facing session
When the agent evaluates the request
Then it acts as combined Product Owner and Engineering Lead and does not spawn leadership or review roles

Scenario: Main agent challenges low-value work
Given a requested task may not be the highest-value vision-aligned next step
When the main agent evaluates what should be done
Then it explains the concern and recommends a better path while recognizing the CEO as final authority

Scenario: Main agent applies inversion
Given a proposed path toward a goal
When the main agent plans and reviews the work
Then it identifies actions, omissions, assumptions, and failure modes that could prevent success

Scenario: Coding agents receive economical settings
Given bounded implementation work is ready to delegate
When the main agent spawns a Coding Agent
Then it uses explicit user model and effort settings when supplied, otherwise the configured economical worker profile

Scenario: Main agent reviews delegated work
Given a Coding Agent returns an implementation report
When the main agent integrates the result
Then it directly inspects the diff, tests, risks, and acceptance evidence before accepting or revising the work
payload.title: Main delivery agent owns judgment and technical delivery
